statement: AWS and NVIDIA cited G7 instances delivering 4.6x AI inference performance and 2.1x graphics performance versus G6, GPU-accelerated data processing up to 3.7x faster with 30% better price performance versus CPU configurations, and vector indexing up to 9x faster at one-quarter the cost.
why: Vendor-stated cost-per-unit-of-work improvements are what make GPU instances displace CPU workloads, widening the addressable base beyond model training.

impact.mechanism: Better price performance against CPUs shifts general data processing and vector search onto GPUs, adding demand outside AI training.

evidence.excerpt: GPU-accelerated data processing delivers 'up to 3.7x faster' speeds with '30% better price performance' versus CPU configurations
vector indexing achieves 'up to 9x faster' performance at 'one-quarter the cost'

confidence.basis: Primary source, but these are vendor marketing benchmarks with no disclosed methodology or workload definition.
